body.name: \(\operatorname{GRect}\)
body.space: algorithms on algebraic Gaussian parameters and rational rectangles
body.def: A terminating outward-rounded primitive that Cholesky-conditions a positive-definite algebraic Gaussian law, truncates one-dimensional tails at error \(\zeta_{\mathrm{tail}}\), adaptively subdivides the resulting compact iterated integral using certified derivative bounds until quadrature width is at most \(\zeta_{\mathrm{quad}}\), and accumulates interval arithmetic with outward-rounding width at most \(\zeta_{\mathrm{round}}\).
